caption: The drawing depicts a detailed, front-facing view of a tall, two-section cabinet rendered in black linework on an off-white background. The top section of the cabinet features two glass-paned doors divided into six rectangular panes each, with hinges visible on the left side of the left door and the right side of the right door. Above the doors, there is a cornice with dentil molding and diagonal side sections, and the width is labeled 35 1/2 inches. The upper section height is marked as 78 1/2 inches. The lower section of the cabinet has two solid rectangular doors, each framed with scalloped trim on the sides and labeled panel dimensions of 15 inches by 18 1/2 inches, with hinges shown on the outer edges. The structure stands on a base with a plinth and shaped feet. Multiple measurement annotations indicate the width, height, depth, and individual part dimensions, such as “Panes 6 3/4 x 14 1/4,” and dimensions of molding and trim. The total height is around 78 1/2 inches according to the vertical dimension given. The composition is symmetric and precise, with all elements laid out according to scale “1/8 inch = 1 foot,” and handwritten notes and dimensions are scattered throughout the drawing. The name “FAIRBAN” is inscribed at the bottom right.
title: Corner Cupboard
